description: The clean run with the ground-truth module in CRLF bytes, as the published September seals hashed it (FINDINGS_ERRATA N2): its ground_truth_hash is theirs, 033ce73d…. The seal hashes a file's raw bytes; the module is also a .py file the runner source hash covers. A runner that read either in text mode would hash the LF form and fail the hash oracle.
exercises: a sealed input with CRLF line endings
scratch_copy: Runs in a scratch copy: the CRLF module is made there, at the sealed default path example/ground_truth_example.py, which in the real tree is a tracked LF file.
